about_the_game:
Explode your friends in this zany, action-packed party brawler for 4 players. Use powerful Mayhem Abilities to fill the screen with danger. Pick up the items & weapons that fall from the sky, and be the last Mascot standing! 

The demo includes 4 playable characters, 2 maps, and 4 items. 

Note: this game is multiplayer only, and can be played locally or with Steam Remote Play. You will need 1 or more controllers to play (one player can choose to use keyboard controls, the rest will need a controller).

short_description: A party brawling game full of explosions and silly antics. Explode your friends! Play as a cast of colorful mascots such as Vanessa, a candle-wielding cupcake full of love (and explosions), and Tox, a slippery lizard who fights to save his swamp! Each mascot has unique abilities and playstyles!
